speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Paraneoplastic Acrokeratosis Neoplastica (Bazex-Dupré-Christol Syndrome). The combination of a pruritic rash on the face and upper body, loss of eyelashes and eyebrows, hypopigmented macules on the elbows, and bilateral hand paresthesia strongly suggests an underlying cutaneous T-cell lymphoma or other malignancy causing paraneoplastic neurologic and cutaneous changes. Given your history of farming and livestock exposure, we must rule out rare occupational exposures, but the specific constellation of eyebrow/eyelash loss and distal paresthesia is a classic presentation of this paraneoplastic syndrome. I will proceed with a biopsy of the hypopigmented macule and a full-body CT scan to screen for an occult malignancy.
